name: Kannazuki Kyouhei
source:
Kyouhei is the vice-commander of Ratatoskr crewing the Fraxinus, a ship located 15,000 meters above Tengu City. Kyouhei is described to be a nice individual with elegant manners. However, he is also a masochist and often let his masochistic antics make his coworkers question his authority and reliability. He constantly likes angering [url=/c14372]Kotori[/url] who always punishes him over these actions, which he satisfies his masochistic tendencies. Despite his fetishes, when in danger or when the situation truly calls for it, Kyouhei has shown to be highly perceptive and analytical in various situations and it is because of these qualities that earned respect from his coworkers as well.
